The '''Red Deck food court''' was a food court located on the [[Rec Deck]] of the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star]]. A new [[Restaurant/Legends|restaurant]] opened up there that served [[Melahnese food|Melahnese]] food.<ref name="Death Star">[[Death Star (novel)|''Death Star'']]</ref>
